upstream.latestChange: BWM commit 4889d2986f7ebba4bd071d2b9895aa5b779ae81c adds power-save/DFS/light-sleep controls, BLE/Wi-Fi modem power-save, link-state broadcasts, a 12 KiB UART RX ring and a 0x55 wake preamble. Commit 23bfa7b21004f91dba64468d398971919fca8eda fixes RX callback teardown ordering. Source-verified only; no physical verification.
upstream.ciMeaning: CI build/package success is evidence of firmware buildability only; it is not physical hardware verification.

cepTransportOpenPr.summary: Proposes clearing stale SPI1 RX overrun data in CEP read/write polling paths. Firmware-only; no Control Center client protocol change.
cepTransportOpenPr.evidence: PR description reports PM5 + Flipper FAP hardware trials; not independently verified by this project.

controlCenterCi.note: Previous run failed due to malformed test fixtures. Corrected test fixture commit has passed Ubuntu; Windows job was still in progress at last observation. Do not mark overall CI passed until all jobs complete.

transport.source: RfidResearchGroup/Proxmark5_BWM_esp32 DEV.md and commit 23bfa7b21004f91dba64468d398971919fca8eda; UART RX buffer size from commit 4889d2986f7ebba4bd071d2b9895aa5b779ae81c
transport.mdnsBuildFlag: CONFIG_PM5_MDNS_ENABLE (Kconfig default y; build may override)

chargerPolicy.reason: No verified PM5+BWM charger-register write/readback path has been established on physical hardware.
chargerPolicy.note: The Control Center must not silently apply a guessed charge-voltage target. Battery chemistry and production charge limits remain hardware/pack specific.

evidenceRule: Upstream source and CI evidence must never be promoted to HARDWARE_VERIFIED without reproducible observation on a physical PM5+BWM unit. BWM power-save and callback changes remain source-verified only. Upstream PR #3728 is open and unmerged; it describes hardware trials but this project has not independently verified them.
integrationPolicy: Control Center now implements native PM5 Wi-Fi/TCP PM3-NG transport and the source-verified BWM ESP32-C2 OTA command protocol. Physical end-to-end verification remains separate. Do not label the wireless stack stable/production-ready.
